name: get_package_profile_info
description:
Retrieve a profile of the target package.
The profile includes package name, version, description, file paths in the package, total number of files, total number of code lines, unique library imports across all files and other relevant metadata. Use this to understand the package to prepare your relevant queries.
Prefer to run this tool at the start of your analysis.

name: execute_codeql_query
description:
Execute a CodeQL query against the package database.
Returns SARIF results with findings.
Use this as your PRIMARY tool for security analysis. Prefer this over reading files manually.
Each query execution counts toward your analysis progress.

codeql_query.description: Complete CodeQL query code to execute. Must follow the CodeQL syntax instructions provided in the system prompt knowledge. If the query returns too many results it will be considered noisy, so prefer to write precise queries or refine them based on previous findings.

hypothesis.description: Brief description of what vulnerability this query is testing for

severity.description: The severity of the hypothesis for this query. Allowed values: critical, high, medium, low

cwe_ids.description: Optional list with CWE IDs associated with this query e.g., cwe-502

name: validate_codeql_query
description:
Validate a CodeQL query by compiling it without executing.
Use this to check query syntax before execution to avoid wasting iterations. Prefer to validate queries before executing them.

codeql_query.description: Raw CodeQL query code to validate

name: fixup_codeql_query
description:
Fix a CodeQL query that fails validation.
This tool uses internal retries (up to 3 model calls), which count toward your model call budget.
Returns the fixed query if successful. Use this to correct syntax errors or deprecated API usage for failed queries.

codeql_query.description: CodeQL query code that needs to be fixed

hypothesis.description: Description of what vulnerability this query tests for

cwe_ids.description: Optional list with CWE IDs associated with this query e.g., cwe-502

severity.description: Severity level: critical, high, medium, or low

name: extract_code_snippet
description:
Returns the raw code snippet between start_line and end_line of the file_path.
Try to not use huge gaps between start_line and end_line to avoid token overconsumption. Use strategically.
If end_line is not provided, it defaults to start_line (single line).

file_path.description: Relative file path from package root

name: grep_search
description: Uses grep to search for a specific pattern in the package files and returns results.

pattern.description: The literal string to search for (e.g., 'safe_load', 'MyClass', 'import requests')

directory.description: The directory path to search in (e.g. '/path/to/something'). If left empty it searches from the package root.

name: trace_dataflow_path
description:
Traces how data flows from a source location to a sink location via a CodeQL trace path query.
Returns all dataflow paths showing how data moves through variables, functions and assignments. Use to understand code flows.
If you already have a codeFlow path there is no need to call this tool.
If you receive too many paths, reduce line_tolerance to limit noise.

source_file.description: Source file path (relative to package root)

sink_file.description: Sink file path (relative to package root)

line_tolerance.description:
Number of lines above and below source_line and sink_line matching for better code flow precision.
Keep this value really low (1-3) to avoid false positives or noise. Default is 1, prefer to use default value as higher values may produce too many irrelevant results.

name: submit_finding
description:
Submit a confirmed vulnerability finding with specific file and line information.
Call this for EACH individual vulnerability instance you confirm (not per query - per specific location).
For queries with multiple results, submit each confirmed location separately.
If you stubmble upon new findings not reported by CodeQL, you have to also submit them via this tool.

codeql_query_uuids.description: Array of codeql_query_uuids that this finding is related to. Include all relevant query UUIDs if this finding originated from multiple queries or was discovered while investigating them. Use empty array [] for new findings discovered independently while reviewing code.

verdict.description: Classification: tp=true positive, fp=false positive, mr=manual review needed

description.description: Brief description of what this vulnerability is (e.g., 'Unsafe __import__ allows arbitrary module import')

file_path.description: Relative file path where vulnerability exists

start_line.description: Line number where vulnerability is located

end_line.description: End line (if multi-line). Can be same as start_line.

reasoning.description: Detailed explanation of why this specific instance is vulnerable

evidence.description: Supporting evidence from your investigation. Should include relevant tool results (code snippets, dataflow traces, context). Structure: {"code_context": "...", "dataflow_analysis": "...", "notes": "..."}. Provide as much detail as possible.

dataflow_path.description: REQUIRED if you called trace_dataflow_path: Copy the complete 'results' array from the tool's response here. Do NOT write a summary - include the raw results. Example: if trace_dataflow_path returns {"success": true, "results": [...]}, copy the [...] array here.

name: get_cwe_context
description: MITRE CWE data for one CWE: name, prevalence, likelihood of exploit and related weaknesses.

name: get_validation_context
description: Validation context for a finding you submitted: the raw file code around it (+-10 lines), the package context and the CVE database context of the package (JSON).

package_classification.description: Your current classification of the package, {"type": [...], "layer": [...]}, used as the package context

name: record_validation
description: Record your validation of a submitted finding, following the validation rubric.

name: finalize_report
description: Call this when you have completed discovery, review and validation and want to submit your report. This terminates the session. Only call when you are confident in your findings.

summary.description: Short markdown summary of the security analysis and key findings

type.description: Types of the package. Can select multiple.

layer.description: Layers of the package. Can use multiple.
